location_description: New Bern, formerly called Newbern, is a city in Craven County, North Carolina, United States. As of the 2010 census it had a population of 29,524, which had risen to an estimated 29,994 as of 2019.  It is the county seat of Craven County and the principal city of the New Bern Metropolitan Statistical Area.
